data.name: Into The Depths
data.detailed_description:
Lead an expedition into the ever-changing caves of the Depths. Build using a wide variety of cards, gather resources and venture into the farthest reaches of this dark place.

Establish Your Settlement

Each turn, use cards to grow your small outpost into a powerful stronghold. At the same time, carefully balance your dwindling resources to survive.

  • Plan your settlement wisely to create powerful synergies between cards.

  • Adapt your strategy and expand your deck by leveling up through the research system. New cards and powerful relics will help you overcome the challenges ahead.

  • Rations might be more valuable than gold in these deserted caverns. The larger your settlement becomes, the harder it is to keep it fed and alive.

Explore the Depths

The Depths is a perilous and ever-changing realm that hides untold riches. As you descend, the environment changes. From the rocky and barren Upper Levels, through the foggy Humid Caves and scorching Magma Caverns, to the deepest Abyss: each biome offers new challenges to overcome. But beware of the dangers lurking in the shadows.

Start over!

Even if you fail, it's not time to give up! Prepare for your next expedition: unlock permanent upgrades in the shop and assemble your starting deck. Procedurally generated caves and a vast collection of cards to choose from will affect your playstyle, making each expedition unique.

Numerous expeditions have failed to conquer the Depths, and yours is no exception. Learn from your mistakes, discover game-changing combinations, and become stronger. Only the most iron-willed will return in fame and glory.

data.short_description: A minimalistic mix of a roguelite city builder and a puzzle game. Assemble your deck, build an outpost and colonize the ever-changing caverns. Discover game-breaking synergies to push deeper into the Depths.
data.supported_languages: English, Russian, French, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Spanish - Spain, German, Spanish - Latin America, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean
